lines.beaver_en: Mr. Kim, I was worried since I heard nothing from you.
lines.en: I'm sorry. My contact was late due to the typhoon.

lines.beaver_en: Did you try to contact us in the meantime?
lines.en: Yes, I put a letter in the postbox last week.

lines.beaver: 서신은 아직 못 받았습니다. 등기로 보내셨습니까?
lines.beaver_en: We haven't received it yet. Did you send it registered?
lines.beaver_roman: Seosineun ajik mot badatseumnida. Deunggiro bonaesyeotseumnikka?
lines.learner: 아니요, 일반 우편이에요. 등기로 할 걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: No, it was regular mail. I should have sent it registered.
lines.roman: Aniyo, ilban upyeonieyo. Deunggiro hal geol geuraesseoyo.

lines.learner: 정전으로 인해 휴대폰이 꺼져서 공중전화를 썼어요.
lines.en: My phone died due to the blackout, so I used a pay phone.
lines.roman: Jeonjeoneuro inhae hyudaeponi kkeojeoseo gongjungjeonhwareul sseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: But we didn't get any call.
lines.learner: 여러 번 전화했는데 계속 통화 중이었어요.
lines.en: I called several times, but it was always busy.
lines.roman: Yeoreo beon jeonhwahaenneunde gyesok tonghwa jungieosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 아, 그 시간에 전화가 많이 몰렸습니다. 죄송합니다.
lines.beaver_en: Ah, we got a flood of calls then. I'm sorry.
lines.beaver_roman: A, geu sigane jeonhwaga mani mollyeotseumnida. Joesonghamnida.
lines.en: It's okay. You must have had lots of calls then.

lines.beaver_en: Do you happen to have a new contact number?
lines.learner: 서신 끝에 추신으로 새 번호를 적었어요.
lines.en: I wrote my new number in a postscript at the end of the letter.
lines.roman: Seosin kkeute chusineuro sae beonhoreul jeogeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll check the letter as soon as it arrives.
lines.en: I wrote you, Ms. Park Seoyeon, as the recipient.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me the new number now?
lines.learner: 네, 문자로 보낼게요. 집 우편함도 매일 확인할게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll text it to you. I'll also check my mailbox at home every day.
lines.roman: Ne, munjaro bonaelgeyo. Jip upyeonhamdo maeil hwaginhalgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Thank you for getting in touch.
lines.learner: 오래 연락 못 드려서 죄송해요. 전화 기다릴게요.
lines.en: Sorry I couldn't reach you for so long. I'll wait for your call.
lines.roman: Orae yeollak mot deuryeoseo joesonghaeyo. Jeonhwa gidarilgeyo.
